text:
Maya: Heads-up, new publisher wants quick bootstrap for AWS/GCP/Azure listing. Core asks: automated IAM setup, branding upload constraints, and billing SKU mapping.
Owen: I can own AWS CFN + docs. Prefer role name format rw-publisher-<slug>-svc. Will add trust policy example.
Sofia: For GCP we'll need service account template and IAM bindings. Also confirm whether we push image to their project or we provide marketplace VM image.
Marcus: Azure requires Offer ID and a publisher tenant. I can generate the offer manifest once we have GUID. Also need VM image URIs if we support marketplace VM.
Tina (Legal): Legal intake required before public listing. If customer requests EU-only data residency, include DPA/EU addendum. Flag any export-controlled usage in the intake.
Maya: Branding specs: PNG 240x80 or SVG, max 2MB, short blurb <= 320 chars. We'll enforce via portal validation.
Owen: Quick CFN snippet I'll include in repo:```yaml
Resources:
  PublisherRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: rw-publisher-${TenantSlug}-svc
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement: [{/* trust policy */}]
```
Sofia: GCP IAM example: service account id = rw-publisher-<slug>@<project>.iam.gserviceaccount.com. Binding roles/storage.objectViewer for images.
Marcus: Asked publisher if they want BYO images or we publish official AMI. Waiting on reply. If BYO, we'll need they provide signed image manifest.
Tina (Legal): I'll review the intake form within 48h once submitted. Also note: marketing copy needs to avoid comparative claims unless approved.
Maya: Action items: Owen CFN + README by EOD tomorrow; Sofia GCP templates + example policies by Wednesday; Marcus to prepare Azure manifest template; Tina legal intake link: https://redwood.internal/legal/publisher-intake.
deploy-bot: Onboarding checklist created: https://redwood.internal/onboard/publisher-checklist 4dd Steps: create roles, upload branding, map SKUs, legal intake.
Owen: I'll post PR with CFN and TF snippets and a small README showing role rotation/keys.
Sofia: Adding GCP sample commands to the repo: `gcloud iam service-accounts create rw-publisher-<slug>` and sample iam-policy-binding.
Marcus: If publisher opts for trial SKU we map to internal plan_id TRIAL_30. Confirmed with billing.
Maya: Great. We'll do a quick follow-up Friday. If anyone unblocks earlier, ping here. :thumbsup:
